Name: Mixed Seeds Expanded
Author: Stoel1994
Description:
[center]This mod overhauls the mechanics of the mixed seeds in Stardew Valley.

Simply put, I have increased the drop rate by having grass have the chance to drop mixed seeds.
Along with this change, I have also expanded the range of crops that can be grown with the mixed seeds every season.

This may not be useful for most players or most runs, but allows more involved play when playing "Anti Capitalist".

[b]UPDATE[/b]

I have redone the physical capabilities of the seeds.

I didn't like how it would grow certain things that were, essentially, game changing and sometimes even useless.
Like, why on gods green earth would i want to be planting bloody Qi seeds on my first day in game? I get that ancient fruit is good, but it feels broken to be growing it in my first spring. and finally, forage. We already get a way to make forage seeds, why would i want to grow even more of them?
These have been removed so we get more of the things we want. Things we would otherwise have to buy from pierre or joja. because screw pierre and joja.

[b]EVEN BETTER UPDATE[/b]

DO WHATEVER YALL WANT, I HAVE THROWN IN A MENU FOR YOU BOIIIIIIIIII
Customize what you want to grow, i have added a menu tab for the GMCM[/center]

Manifest.Name: Mixed Seeds Expanded
Manifest.Description: Increases the chance of Mixed Seeds from fiber and allows them to grow all of the seasons growables.
Manifest.Author: Michael Stoelwinder
